concept.title: Crystal Hollow Night Hunt
concept.logline: On rain-soaked, serene Ormorholm, you scour every corner to recover the lantern cores and restore the Resonance Stone.
concept.source_prompt: Crystal Hollow. crystal crystals hollow cavern adventure The hunt
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Prospector Dome and becomes the one who brings the Resonance Stone back to life.

key_locations.name: Prospector Dome
key_locations.description: The start: Prospector Dome, where every trail of the grand loop begins.

key_locations.description: Landing Pad: a dock on the way out from Prospector Dome.

characters.name: Keeper Nadia
characters.description: Waits in Prospector Dome and knows why the Resonance Stone fell silent.

characters.name: Ember the Deckhand
characters.description: Follows you from Prospector Dome and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Hunter Drone
characters.description: A hunter drone that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Hunter Drone 2
characters.description: A hunter drone that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Security Drone
characters.description: A security drone that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Corin the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Ormorholm for anything shiny.

characters.name: Maintenance Bot
characters.description: A harmless maintenance bot that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Defeat every hostile in close combat
hazards: Hunter Drone hunting near its lair
Security Drone patrolling a fixed loop

actions.value: On rain-soaked, serene Ormorholm, you scour every corner to recover the lantern cores and restore the Resonance Stone.
3 hostiles roam Crystal Hollow Night Hunt. Close in and strike with E.
The land is safe again. The bounty is yours.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: So you've come to Prospector Dome at last. I am Keeper Nadia. On rain-soaked, serene Ormorholm, you scour every corner to recover the lantern cores and restore the Resonance Stone.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: Back again. Prospector Dome is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: Go to Landing Pad, then Rover Depot. Whatever still remembers Crystal Hollow Night Hunt is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Prospector Dome, Crystal Hollow Night Hunt was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Dreamlike, even then.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: Landing Pad: Landing Pad: a dock on the way out from Prospector Dome.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Crystal Hollow Night Hunt back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Nadia
nodes.text: Rover Depot: Rover Depot: a camp on the way out from Prospector Dome.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Deckhand
nodes.text: Ember the Deckhand circles your feet, then looks toward Crystal Grotto as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Deckhand
nodes.text: Ember the Deckhand sniffs the air. Something about Crystal Grotto has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Deckhand
nodes.text: It turns toward Crystal Grotto. Crystal Grotto: a cave on the way out from Prospector Dome.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Prospector Dome. Corin the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Crystal Hollow Night Hunt that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Rover Depot after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Maintenance Bot
nodes.text: The maintenance bot freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
